verses.text: The LORD your God will destroy the nations whose land he is giving you. When you have driven them out and are living in their towns and houses,
set apart three cities for yourselves in the land the LORD your God is giving you to own.
Build roads to them, and divide the land the LORD your God is giving you as your own into three parts. Then anyone who kills a person can run to one of these cities.
This is the rule for someone who kills a person and runs there to save their life: they must have killed their neighbour by accident, without hating them beforehand.

For example, a man may go into the forest with his neighbour to cut wood. As he swings the axe to chop down a tree, the head may fly off the handle and hit his neighbour and kill him. That man may run to one of these cities and save his life.

Otherwise, the dead person's relative who has the duty to punish the killer might chase him in a rage. If the road is long, he might catch him and kill him, even though the man did not deserve to die, since he had not hated his neighbour before.
That is why I command you to set apart three cities for yourselves.
The LORD your God may make your land larger, as he promised your ancestors, and give you all the land he promised them.

He will do this if you carefully obey all these commands I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God and always live the way he wants. Then you must set apart three more cities in addition to these three.
Do this so that innocent people will not be killed in the land the LORD your God is giving you as your own, and you will not be guilty of their death.
But suppose a man hates his neighbour, hides and waits for him, attacks him and kills him, and then runs to one of these cities.
The leaders of his own town must send for him, bring him back from the city, and hand him over to the relative who has the duty to punish the killer, so that he dies.
Do not feel sorry for him. You must clear Israel of the guilt of killing innocent people, so that all will go well with you.
Do not move your neighbour's boundary stone, which was set up by those who came before you, in the land you will receive as your own in the land the LORD your God is giving you to take over.
One witness is not enough to prove that a person is guilty of any crime or sin they may have done. A matter must be proven by the word of two or three witnesses.
If a lying witness stands up to accuse someone of a crime,
both people in the quarrel must stand in the presence of the LORD before the priests and the judges who are in office at that time.
The judges must look into the case carefully. If the witness is proven to be a liar who has told lies about a fellow Israelite,
then do to the lying witness what that witness wanted to do to the other person. You must get rid of the evil from among you.
The rest of the people will hear about it and be afraid, and no one will ever again do such an evil thing among you.
Do not feel sorry for them. The punishment must match the crime: a life for a life, an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth, a hand for a hand, a foot for a foot.
